correctness.rationale: A still-available edge has never rung: both its endpoints were vacant at all earlier times, so an earlier first ring would have been accepted. Memorylessness therefore gives precisely the stated weighted race. The recursion is finite and analytic from the positive side at both rescaled endpoints: each factor has nonzero constant denominator or a common factor of the slow rate cancels. An independent exact reconstruction (python3 /workspace/reviews/evidence-4.py) used vacant-set distributions modulo translations, with rational Taylor jets for edge-race factors. It reproduced the whole equal-rate distribution, the exact comparison probabilities, the four Q3 antipodal pairs of mass 1/21 each with perfect mass 17/21, all three weak jets including the negative first derivative, and strong jets (1,0,-36). At positive weak rate couple all clocks; the probability the 24 ordinary first arrivals precede the eight distinguished arrivals tends to one. Within each fast-jammed half, only twin vacancies across the halves remain joinable; two identical antipodal pairs give the repair, mass 4/441, while one defective or two different defective halves cannot heal. In dimensions 2 and 3 the halves are K2 or the 4-cycle and all maximal matchings are perfect. The strict inequalities and larger endpoint limits force finite interior minima; no uniqueness follows. The nonconstant rational law also rules out flat intervals of local minima.
residual_risks: Eventual outcomes only; no fixed-time discontinuity or asymptotic result in the dimension is established.
